description: What changed on the board since a stored state_hash: names that entered or left the READY candidate pool, per-name trend-state / light / leadership / hold-band flips, and any regime or permission-ladder move per book. Takes an optional `since`, a state_hash returned by an earlier call. When `since` is omitted it returns only the board's current state_hash and its as-of date. Access: free without `since` (no wallet, no key). With `since`: Coil Live is a subscription with a 7-day free trial; subscribers connect the Coil Live connector and sign in, and this read returns live data. Agents with an x402 wallet can also pay per call; a call with neither returns a PaymentRequired object and no data. An unchanged `since` is answered free and never billed.

since.description: Optional. A state_hash (16 hex chars) returned by an earlier call; omit it to receive the current state_hash.

name: get_board_changes
